Recorded:        2026-08-20

WHY THE BYTES ARE COMMITTED RATHER THAN FETCHED

Because Chromium's own route cannot produce a reproducible checkout for a fork.
`third_party/android_deps` commits no jars — its .gitignore ignores cipd/ and
every DEPS entry pins a CIPD package in a namespace TaffyGo cannot publish to —
and the roller regenerates the build files a new entry would have to live in.
Decision 0031 records the four recurrences of that clobber (OD-076) and chooses
an overlay-owned prebuilt instead, at zero upstream patch cost.

WHAT SHIPS AND WHAT DOES NOT

66,157 of the 9,666,808 bytes reach a device. Everything else runs on the
build host inside kapt and is never dexed. README.chromium states this per
artifact in its Shipped field, and that is the field about:credits reads.

WHAT REPLACING THESE COSTS

A version bump is a Dagger bump: change gradle/libs.versions.toml and the
TOOLCHAIN.md row, re-resolve, copy the new artifacts in under their new
versioned names, and update this file, README.chromium and the BUILD.gn
together. The file names carry versions so that a stale record cannot look
current.

TaffyGo owns vulnerability tracking for these 16 files. Chromium's
android_deps vulnerability flow does not see them, and no lane checks them
today — that gap is stated in decision 0031 rather than papered over.
